evals.prompt:
Run ui-foundation in setup mode for this project. Skip the interview — here are all the design decisions pre-decided:

- Personality: cozy, personal, bookish
- Namespace: --nook-
- Color modes: light and dark
- Density: spacious, rounded corners
- Accent color: terracotta hsl(18 55% 42%)
- Neutral temperature: warm gray
- Typography: system sans-serif stack, semibold headings
- Target devices: mobile-first, responsive to desktop
- Viewports: mobile 375×812, tablet 768×1024, desktop 1280×800
- Toasts: bottom-center, 4s auto-dismiss
- Confirmations: inline undo via toast
- Forms: validate on blur and submit, errors below field

Write tokens.css and ui-project.md. The project uses Vite + React + TypeScript. The main CSS entry is src/styles/tokens.css. Do NOT read any ui-base.md — the skill and its references are your only guidance.
evals.expected_output: The skill should generate src/styles/tokens.css with @layer tokens (three tiers: primitive, semantic, component) AND a separate @layer base block that applies background-color and color to body using semantic tokens. Without @layer base, body/html keep browser-default white and the design system does not control the page surface. Also generates .claude/rules/ui-project.md with token names and usage rules using the --nook- namespace.
expectations: The generated tokens.css contains a @layer base block (literal text '@layer base')
The @layer base block includes a body selector that sets background-color using var(--nook-bgColor-default)
The @layer base block includes a body selector that sets color using var(--nook-fgColor-default)
The @layer tokens block exists with primitive, semantic, and component tiers
Dark mode overrides exist under :root[data-theme='dark'] inside @layer tokens
The @layer base block is separate from @layer tokens — they are two distinct layer blocks
No raw color values (hex, hsl, rgb) appear outside of @layer tokens primitive tier
The generated ui-project.md references the --nook- namespace

evals.prompt:
Run ui-foundation in setup mode for this project. Skip the interview — here are all the design decisions pre-decided:

- Personality: clean, efficient, modern
- Namespace: --syn-
- Color modes: light and dark
- Density: compact, sharp corners
- Accent color: emerald hsl(160 50% 38%)
- Neutral temperature: cool gray
- Typography: system sans-serif stack, medium headings
- Target devices: desktop-first, responsive to mobile
- Viewports: mobile 375×812, tablet 768×1024, desktop 1280×800
- Toasts: top-right, 3s auto-dismiss
- Confirmations: dialog
- Forms: validate on submit, errors below field

The project has stylelint-config-standard configured (see .stylelintrc.json). Write tokens.css and ui-project.md. The project uses Vite + React + TypeScript. The main CSS entry is src/styles/tokens.css. Do NOT read any ui-base.md — the skill and its references are your only guidance.
evals.expected_output: The skill should generate src/styles/tokens.css with @layer tokens and @layer base, AND .claude/rules/ui-project.md with a ## Syntax section containing T1 enforcement blocks. Because the project has stylelint-config-standard, the generated ui-project.md must include: (1) a no-bem-separators T1 block that catches BEM __ and -- in class selectors, and (2) a media-range-notation T1 block that catches legacy (min-width:) / (max-width:) syntax.
expectations: The generated ui-project.md contains a ## Syntax section
The ## Syntax section contains an enforcement block with id: "no-bem-separators"
The no-bem-separators block has tier: T1
The no-bem-separators block has a pattern matching BEM __ in class selectors
The no-bem-separators block has a pattern matching BEM -- in class selectors
The no-bem-separators block has assert: absent
The no-bem-separators block has scope: "src/**/*.css"
The no-bem-separators block has strip: comments
The ## Syntax section contains an enforcement block with id: "media-range-notation"
The media-range-notation block has tier: T1
The media-range-notation block has a pattern matching (min-width: or (max-width: or (min-height: or (max-height:
The media-range-notation block has assert: absent
The media-range-notation block has scope: "src/**/*.css"
The generated ui-project.md references the --syn- namespace
The generated tokens.css contains a @layer base block
